annotations.title: Full repo security report (paid, 0.25 USDC x402)

description: PAID (0.25 USDC via x402 on Base, per call). Full pre-run security report for a GitHub repo (1-3 repos per call), for AI coding agents about to clone it and run its install steps. Everything check_repo does, plus: package.json install/lifecycle scripts and the local scripts they run, typosquatted crypto/AI dependencies, install.sh/setup.sh/setup.py/requirements.txt/Makefile, VS Code autorun tasks and settings, dev-container hooks, agent-instruction files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, copilot-instructions, .claude hooks/permissions) and MCP server configs shipped in the repo, committed executables and archives from the full file tree, GitHub fake-star / new-owner signals, a 0-100 risk score and concrete next steps. Optional: also checks a command you plan to run. Unpaid calls return an x402 PaymentRequired (isError) result; retry with the signed payment in params._meta["x402/payment"]. You are charged only if the report is delivered.

command.description: optional: an install/run command you plan to execute for this repo

repo.description: github.com/owner/repo or owner/repo (or up to 3, comma-separated)

repos.description: optional instead of repo: 1-3 repos in one paid call

name: full_report
